description: K₂NaTlBr₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent Br atoms to form distorted KBr₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent TlBr₆ octahedra. All K-Br bond lengths are 4.01 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Tl is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form TlBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-Br bond lengths are 2.77 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Tl atom.
